content: Due to planned track work, this XPT service will terminate at Strathfield. Passengers travelling to Sydney/Central will need to make their way on a T2 suburban train service to Sydney/Central (Please check indicators on arrival at Strathfield).

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace the 01:47 Central to Newcastle Interchange service from Central to Hornsby
infoLinks.content:
Thursday 23 and Friday 24 April  
  • Buses replace the 01:47 Central to Newcastle Interchange service from Central to Hornsby. Replacement buses leave Central at 1.21am, 26 minutes earlier than the normal train timetable.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route
92T9 Central, express to Hornsby
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Train trackwork on the City Circle and T1 North Shore Line may affect how you travel
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 9 and Sunday 10 May 
  • Train trackwork on the City Circle and T1 North Shore Line may affect how you travel.
  • Trains do not run between Central and Wynyard, or on the City Circle.
  • Use light rail services between Central and Circular Quay.
  • For travel to T1 North Shore Line stations change at Wynyard.

  • Sydney Metro services do not run between Tallawong and Sydenham.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to train and metro planned trackwork alerts.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Goulburn, Moss Vale and Campbelltown
infoLinks.content:
Monday 4 May
  • From 2am to 3pm, buses replace trains between Goulburn, Moss Vale and Campbelltown.
  • You may need to change buses to continue your journey.
  • T8 Airport & South Line trains run between Macarthur and the City via the Airport.
  • The first train to run towards Moss Vale is the 13:00 Campbelltown to Moss Vale service.
  • The first train to run towards Campbelltown is the 13:27 Moss Vale to Campbelltown service.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

5SH Goulburn, all stations to Moss Vale and return

9SH Moss Vale, Bowral, Mittagong, Picton, Campbelltown and return
